headline: Kajetan Schweighofer takes 15th as ARC-2 gold line rises

sections.text: Kajetan Schweighofer moved into the 15 gold places, rising from 17th to 15th at 58.06 (+3.62). ARCward Intelligence fell from 15th to 16th at 57.08, unchanged.
The cutoff rose 0.98 in the past day to 58.06, leaving ARCward Intelligence 0.98 short of the last gold place.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
